assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation. Referenced throughout compliance_matrix.json, standard_matrix.json, and design_depth_matrix.json.

assumptions.statement: SITE-001 is a maintainer-provided provisional_constraint (official_boundary=false, geometry_role=provisional_constraint, boundary_precision=provisional_rough) built from announcement text, an approximate ~11.4 km² figure, and named-road landmarks, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: site_area_sqm and every ratio computed against it (green_ratio, public_space_ratio, and all unknown current-condition ratios) are provisional and must be fully recalculated — not patched file-by-file — once an official SITE_BOUNDARY polygon is published.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-001/002/003 are maintainer-provided provisional_constraint rectangles inferred from the announcement's key-area names, north-to-south order, and approximate areas (192.1 ha / 104.3 ha / 72.0 ha); they are not official key-area polygons and their edges are not parcel or road-redline boundaries.
assumptions.impact: key_area_count is reproducible from submitted geometry, but the station envelopes (BLDG-ST01/02/03-001), public-space nodes (N1-N6), and constraint catchments sited inside them inherit the same provisional precision and must be re-sited once official KEY_AREA polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: geometry/land_use.geojson (LU-001..LU-006) is a diagrammatic, agent-generated six-part partition of SITE-001 expressing the heritage-spine / three-station / two-wing organization, not an existing land-use survey or a statutory control-detailed-plan zoning boundary.
assumptions.impact: Land-use codes and shares are design discussion material only; they carry no regulatory force and must be replaced by a licensed control-detailed-plan process before any statutory use.

assumptions.statement: BLDG-ST01-001, BLDG-ST02-001, and BLDG-ST03-001 are small conceptual intervention envelopes (survey_status=pending_survey) marking where new/renovated function could be sited inside each provisional key area; existing-building status, ownership, floor count, height, floor area, FAR, and retain/renovate/demolish decisions are not asserted.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm is reproducible from the three submitted envelopes only; it is not a claim about existing building stock and cannot support FAR, density, or retain/renovate/demolish quantities until a building survey exists.

assumptions.statement: ROAD-AXIS-001, ROAD-WING-TECH-001, ROAD-WING-XIAOYUE-001, ROAD-STITCH-N4, and ROAD-STITCH-N5 are conceptual, editable slow-mobility design links (greenway / pedestrian / transit_connection), not existing or approved roads, railway alignments, crossings, or engineering structures.
assumptions.impact: conceptual_mobility_length_m is a design-intent length only; it cannot be read as a constructed or approved road network, and crossing/engineering forms mentioned in the proposal remain for professional teams to study.

assumptions.statement: GREEN-AXIS-001, GREEN-QINGHE-001, GREEN-XIAOYUE-001, GREEN-ST01-001, GREEN-ST02-001, and GREEN-ST03-001 express shade, detention, seasonal refuge, and station-commons concepts only; they are not existing water, blue lines, ecological protection controls, or engineered detention/flood-control capacity.
assumptions.impact: green_ratio is a proposed-concept ratio, not a current-condition ratio, and cannot support any flood-control or ecological-capacity claim without a hydrology model and blue-line survey.

assumptions.statement: N1-N6 are proposed public-space prototype nodes with proposed scenario_ids, operating_modes, priority_users, prerequisites, and manual_fallback content; they are design proposals, not confirmed operators, approved activity permits, or verified land ownership/management responsibility.
assumptions.impact: public_space_ratio, prototype_node_count, scenario_count, industry_test_count, declared_reversible_prototype_ratio, and declared_manual_fallback_documentation_ratio are all reproducible from this submitted layer only and describe design intent, not operating fact.

assumptions.statement: Scenario tags S01-S10 attached to N1-N6 correspond to the ten AI scenario cards described in proposal.md Chapter 6; S08, S09, and S10 are the three required industry test/validation scenarios and are marked with industry_test_scenario_ids on each hosting node.
assumptions.impact: scenario_count and industry_test_count are reproducible from geometry/public_space.geojson; none of the ten scenarios has run in production, so any performance indicator for them remains unknown (see metrics.json fail_safe_pass_rate, participation_outcomes).

assumptions.statement: geometry/constraints.geojson contains only editable AI_SERVICE_ZONE analysis-helper polygons (CONSTRAINTS, WING-TECH-001, WING-XIAOYUE-001) with not_an_official_control=true; no REGULATORY_CONTROL, HERITAGE_PROTECTION, WATER_SYSTEM, EXISTING_RAIL, or other editable_by_agent=false layer is generated because that source data does not exist in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Official control lines, ownership, existing buildings, municipal, fire, heritage, hydrology, accessibility, and engineering data remain unresolved data gaps (see CONSTRAINTS.missing_official_data) that a professional team must close before statutory design.

assumptions.statement: WING-TECH-001 and WING-XIAOYUE-001 are conceptual service catchments (review gates) for the two wings, not land-allocation or regulatory control lines; CONSTRAINTS may geometrically overlap them because it encodes applicability across the whole domain, not a land-use assignment.
assumptions.impact: wing_count is reproducible from the two named road wings plus their matching catchment polygons; catchment extents are indicative only and are not a service-level or capacity guarantee.

assumptions.statement: PHASE-001 (90-day standards and no-personal-data drill), PHASE-002 (one-year reversible public pilot), and PHASE-003 (annual renew/modify/stop cycle) are conceptual, reversible PHASE polygons with personal_data_allowed=false and reversible=true; no construction date, budget, procurement commitment, or approved implementation status is claimed.
assumptions.impact: phase_count is reproducible from the three submitted phase polygons; exit_trigger and decision_owner fields name a proposed, not-yet-constituted governance role only, consistent with proposal.md Chapter 6.

assumptions.statement: The Haidian AI Axis Open Operations Consortium referenced by phasing decision_owner fields and by manual-fallback/reversibility commitments does not currently exist; this proposal designates no institution, enterprise, or individual for any role in it and involves no budget, approval, SLA, or procurement commitment.
assumptions.impact: declared_reversible_prototype_ratio, declared_manual_fallback_documentation_ratio, and every phase's exit_trigger describe the submitted design layer's declared properties only; they are not evidence that governance authority, funding, or a charter exists.

assumptions.statement: Public sources report verified Haidian-Ulanqab cooperation facts (an AI-industry cooperation memorandum signed between Haidian District and Ulanqab City, government-reported point-to-point optical cables and link-level latency figures, and a case-specific data-center PUE figure; see proposal.en.md source registry); no project-specific agreement/SLA/dataset or approval/operating evidence has been provided to or independently verified for this submission as of 2026-08-08; public cooperation facts do not establish this proposal architecture. No project-specific agreement/SLA/dataset has been provided to or independently verified for this submission as of 2026-08-08, so no capacity, price, SLA, investment amount, fiscal commitment, or construction timeline is asserted for the dispatch architecture.
assumptions.impact: All haidian_ulanqab_* metrics remain unknown with value=null; the dispatch ledger described in proposal.md can only exist as a test-specification/metering-definition structure until intergovernmental and commercial agreements are reached. The verified cooperation facts above may be cited as background policy context only, never as capacity, price, SLA, or operating-architecture evidence for this proposal.

assumptions.statement: No project-specific agreement/SLA/dataset has been provided to or independently verified for this submission as of 2026-08-08 for the following data classes: official control-detailed-plan control lines, ownership/parcel records, existing-building survey, municipal utility network and capacity, fire protection conditions, heritage protection lines, hydrology/flood-control model and blue lines, accessibility condition survey, and engineering feasibility studies for any crossing or structure.
assumptions.impact: Every metric and proposal claim that would require these data classes is kept status=unknown with value=null and an explicit reason in metrics.json; none is estimated, illustrated, or backfilled with a placeholder value.

assumptions.statement: Resident/worker population counts, demand projections, and accessibility-service coverage (e.g. walk-time or transit coverage) for the site and surrounding catchment are not present in the public site package and are not estimated by this submission.
assumptions.impact: No population-served, demand, or accessibility-coverage metric is claimed in metrics.json; priority_users fields in public_space.geojson describe intended beneficiary groups only, not measured usage or coverage.

assumptions.statement: Cost, construction schedule, financial return, and job-creation figures require a feasibility study, cost consultant, and economic analysis that have not been performed for this concept-stage submission.
assumptions.impact: No cost, schedule, return, or employment metric appears in metrics.json; phasing.geojson duration_note fields describe a proposed governance/review rhythm only, not a construction timeline or budget.

assumptions.statement: The fail-safe scenario pass rate and public-participation outcomes referenced in proposal.md Chapter 6 have not been measured because no scenario card, drill, or pilot described in phasing.geojson/public_space.geojson has yet run.
assumptions.impact: fail_safe_pass_rate and participation_outcomes-type metrics remain unknown with value=null; they can only be populated after PHASE-001 drills and later pilots actually execute and are evaluated by a confirmed governance body.
